source: docs/P3_DATASET_DESIGN.md sections 5, 6 and 8 (approved 2026-10-30, D-D2, D-D3, D-D4, D-D5); docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md section 13 item 3
rule: Frozen before the first training capture (P3 note section 8 item 3). A change is a new file version, labelled post hoc; tests/test_p3_prereg.py pins every value.

eval_extension.rule: n_eval = ceil(10 * (hw_pred / 8) ** 2), capped at 20, decided from the two validation captures before any evaluation capture is scored; only the count may change

volume.eval_tail_note: evaluation captures only: the 240 s slot after the core phases holds C3b@M3 and the held-out benign kinds, and the 120 s benign tail follows it as in every capture, so 60 + 3 x 240 + 240 + 120 = 1140 s
volume.eval_tail_label: re-registered 2026-10-31, before any capture: 1020 -> 1140 s, confirmed by the user at 14:46:37Z ('Confirm 1140 s', D-036). Committed in 7b40c86 (12:51Z) as part of the D-034 round (T038-01), whose text does not cover the capture length: until D-036 that label was a forward reference (T-042 F05). With key lifetimes from one law (ml/l7v2_prereg.json arrivals.lifetimes), an M3 bot needs the tail after its slot that the last core slot has, or its lifetimes, and so its window ages, are cut short (window-age AUC 0.31 at seed 3201 without it)
volume.benign_users_min_note: re-registered 2026-10-31 by the user, before any capture: 200 -> 120 users per capture seed (200 do not fit the 300 verified aliases next to the L7 v2 classes; T-025a F3)

age_only_ip_ua.label: registered 2026-10-31 under D-040 (the orchestrator's T-042 follow-ups, 15:48:50Z; finding T042-F01), before any capture
age_only_ip_ua.key: the request level's key, (IP, UA): l7_ingest.key_of, as train_l7.group_windows groups the windows
age_only_ip_ua.score: age = the window's last request start minus the start of its (IP, UA) key's first request in its capture; p = the share of the training benign windows that are older (ties count one half), so a younger window scores higher
age_only_ip_ua.operating_point: the curves' own rule (train_l7.operating_point on the validation windows, the theta and k grids and the benign budget above)
age_only_ip_ua.reading: the AUC of p, attack windows against benign windows of the validation captures, within 0.5 +- auc_band is 'near chance'; otherwise every request-level curve result is labelled 'age-assisted': a benign device keeps its address and UA for the whole capture, so (IP, UA) key age can carry the role (T042-F01)
age_only_ip_ua.report: its validation AUC pooled and per family, its reading, and its recall at its operating point on the evaluation captures, beside the curves; the view level keys by (IP, UA, sid) and has its own age-only baseline (ml/l7v2_model_prereg.json baselines.age_only)
